name: Spatter
author: Erin Carter
description: Near-black wet glass, almost empty. At hash-timed instants a raindrop strikes, drawing a tiny asymmetric splat with angular spikes that flares in a palette hue chosen by position, then relaxes into a single bead that slides a short way down the pane and fades, over a quiet stipple of old rain. Stochastic, percussive, no global pulse.

params.label: Splat rate
params.effect: Average rain-strike frequency across the pane, from a lone tap every few seconds to a steady patter of overlapping hits.

params.label: Splat size
params.effect: Radius in CSS pixels of each impact splat and its resulting bead, from fine drizzle to fat heavy drops.

params.label: Slide
params.effect: Distance in CSS pixels the relaxed bead slides before fading; 0 makes drops die where they land, high values leave short running tails.
